basis: A working man of 1835 on a wagon bench: a short drab-brown wool round jacket closed over his waistcoat with four horn buttons, and a low-crowned, broad-brimmed felt hat. Cut, colour and fit are reconstructed authoring choices; no surviving garment, picture or record of what Otis Bardwell wore is claimed.

garments.name: round_jacket
garments.source_scope: Terminology only: transcription-mediated June/July 1835 advertisements list round jackets among men's clothing; no cut, colour, wearer or before-scene stock is attested.
garments.note: A waist-length round jacket stood off his shirt and waistcoat by a wool's loft, with a low standing collar.

garments.name: jacket_buttons
garments.note: Four dark horn buttons closing the jacket.

garments.name: felt_hat
garments.note: A low-crowned, broad-brimmed wool felt hat, the brim drooping a little fore and aft.
